Part B (AB or BC): Graphing Calculator Not Allowed 
Question 3 
9 points 

General Scoring Notes 

• 
The model solution is presented using standard mathematical notation. 

• 
Answers (numeric or algebraic) need not be simplified. Answers given as a decimal approximation should 
be accurate to three places after the decimal point. Within each individual free-response question, at most 
one point is not earned for inappropriate rounding.
